_comment: R2: the TS xApp decides from the stub QP's fixed predictions, R0 radio config (RngRun 1, outageThreshold -1000): IMSIs 1,2 start on cell 3 (gNB 3), IMSIs 3-6 on cell 2 (gNB 2). Each trigger is one 30003 naming one UE (decimal IMSI as a string), one trigger per step; each IMSI is used in one step only. predictions = the stub's answer, serving cell first, unsigned integers [dl, ul], never a tie. The TS xApp hands over when the best cell's dl exceeds serving dl x (1 + threshold/100); it addresses the control to the TARGET's E2 node (recorded deviation P1), so via = the target gNB. Negatives: n1 the serving cell is best; n2 a neighbour 5 % above the serving cell, under the 10 % threshold (with threshold 0 it would hand over, so n2 proves the A1 policy took effect). The threshold is rung-config.json a1_threshold.

calibration._comment: W calibration in the gated per-step shape (one trigger per step, the same agents): count positive triggers from firstStep every everySteps steps, IMSIs round robin 1..6, each sent to the cell it is not on (start cells below, flipped after each trigger), predictions serving [100, 0] then target [300, 0]. Only L and the one-control-per-trigger count are judged; outcomes are recorded.
